Commentary.Commentary: We're back! The series is on the line. West Indies regroup near the boundary line before spreading on the field. Glorious conditions, the sun is shining brightly and the conditions looking ripe for batting. Paul Stirling and William Porterfield are the Irish openers. Alzarri Joseph with the first new ball. Here we go...
... THE CHASE ...

Ireland didn't start well with the ball but made a resounding comeback. Every time their players were heard shouting that West Indies lose wickets in a clumps and that's what eventually happened. Craig Young and Andy McBrine were the cornerstones of their bowling attack and the latter, in particular, was too hot to handle on a surface that was offering good grip and bounce. The Irish team would have loved to bundle out West Indies under 200 and had the opportunity to do so as well but they dropped Jason Holder in the 34th over and he along with Akeal Hosein added another 36 runs after that missed chance. Will that come back to haunt Ireland? We will find out shortly.

It's almost a carbon copy batting from West Indies. Kieron Pollard lost the toss yet again and his team was invited to bat first on a surface that had moisture in it. The start although was bright and breezy for West Indies as Shai Hope batted ultra aggressively. The hosts managed 69 runs in Powerplay 1 but then it all went pear-shaped. The wickets started to tumble at a rate of knots and West Indies slipped from 72/0 to 119/7 in no time. The 63-run partnership between Jason Holder and Akeal Hosein helped the home team avoid embarrassment and now they have at least a fighting total on the board.

Good recovery in the end from West Indies but still, it's a sorry batting card for them. Once again they failed to bat out their full quota and have managed a below-par total. Ireland would be happy with their performance in the field and they would have taken this target on any day.

OUT! CAUGHT! Craig Young strikes and takes the last wicket. A fullish ball, outside off. Alzarri Joseph looks to drive, but he is a tad early into his shot and ends up chipping it to extra cover. Paul Stirling gets low and takes a sharp catch. West Indies are all out for 212!
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, outside off. Odean Smith moves across and drills it towards long on for a single.
Free Hit to follow...
NO BALL AND FOUR! Another fuller ball, wide outside off. Odean Smith hangs back and slaps it towards deep cover for a boundary. A no-ball called for overstepping.
A length ball, shaping away, wide outside off. Odean Smith looks to slash this, but fails to reach the ball. That should have been a wide.
The search is on for the ball. They have failed to find it. The reserve umpire comes out with a bag of balls.
SIX! Oh my word, this one goes nearly in the top tier. This lad can hit. Fuller in length, around off, right in the slot, Odean tees off and launches it over wide long on for a massive six.
Craig Young (7-0-31-2) is back on.
Maiden to finish his exceptional spell! Tossed up around off, Joseph defends it carefully. 10-2-28-4, take a bow, McBrine.
Flatter, around off. Alzarri Joseph pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker again, a touch shorter. Alzarri Joseph punches it to mid-wicket. Another dot ball.
Much quicker this time, outside off. Alzarri Joseph dabs it to backward point.
Outside off, fuller ball. Alzarri Joseph cuts it towards backward point.
A loopy ball, fuller and around middle. Alzarri Joseph pushes it back to the bowler.
Smart batting! Length delivery, around middle, Alzarri Joseph comes across and flicks it to fine leg for a single. That brings up the 200 for West Indies!
FOUR! Stand and deliver! A full ball, on middle, Alzarri Joseph stands tall and smokes it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Wide of off this time, on a fuller length. Odean Smith slashes it towards deep cover for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Alzarri Joseph, on the back foot, punches it past cover for a single.
On a length, much quicker, outside off. Alzarri Joseph blocks it out solidly.
Josh Little takes the pace off, serves a fuller ball, on off. Odean Smith drills it towards long on for a single.
Alzarri Joseph is the last batsman.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Andy McBrine, take a bow! He serves a flatter ball, on middle, Akeal Hosein stays in his crease and punches it aerially to the left of the bowler. McBrine keeps his eyes on the ball and throws himself in that direction as he takes a stunning return catch.
Shorter, on middle. Akeal Hosein stays in the crease and blocks it out.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! Andy McBrine changes his angle this time, goes 'round the wicket, outside off. Odean Smith takes him on again and lofts it towards long off. Curtis Campher gets low but fails to grab an easy catch there. This could prove to be costly. The batsmen cross.
SIX! BOOM! Odean Smith gets off the mark in style! Very full this time, outside off. Odean Smith gets low and tonks this over long on for a biggie.
Quicker this time, outside off. Odean Smith hangs back and blocks it out.
Loopy ball, around middle and leg. Akeal Hosein leans forward and tucks it towards square leg. One run is taken.
Touch fuller, outside off. Akeal Hosein pushes it toward covers for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Odean Smith looks to pull this, but the ball deflects off his pads and rolls towards deep square leg for a leg bye.
Odean Smith walks out to the middle now.

OUT! Run out! A sad end to this promising partnership for West Indies. Slightly short in length, around middle, Holder tucks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single. He is eager for the second run and calls his partner through. Jason uses his long legs to march towards the keeper's end but before that Gareth Delany fires in a perfect throw to Neil Rock who does the rest. They appeal and then start to celebrate. The third umpire is referred and one replay is enough to give Holder out. Way outside the crease. End of a good knock.
Appeal for a run out. It's referred upstairs...
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it towards mid on.
Back of a length, around off, Akeal jumps and drops it with gentle hands to covers for a quick run.
Play and a miss! Clever change in pace, short and outside off, Akeal flashes his blade early and misses. Holder has a word with his partner, perhaps asking him to keep his composure.
Wide! Short and way too wide outside off, left alone.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning.
Much quicker, sliding it on leg. Akeal Hosein works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, around off. Akeal Hosein pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker, and shorter. Jason Holder, on the back foot, punches it to long on for a single.
FOUR! SWEPT AWAY! A loopy ball, on middle. Jason Holder gets down and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Fuller again, slower through the air. Jason Holder pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Fuller, on the stumps. Akeal Hosein drives it long on for a single.
FOUR! A no ball proved costly for Ireland! A fuller ball, outside off. Jason Holder throws his arms at it and gets a thick outside edge to third man for a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up.
NO BALL! A fuller ball, outside off. Jason Holder leans and looks to drive, but fails to get any bat on it. Josh Little has overstepped here, a no ball is given.

A little bit of confusion there but safe! A length ball, outside off. Jason Holder lunges and taps it towards point. A direct hit at the bowler's end, tempts the batters to take a single, but they decide against it in the end.
Good-length delivery, darting it on the pads this time. Akeal Hosein works it towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Akeal Hosein leans and defends that one.
Pulls his length back this time, outside off. Akeal Hosein taps it to cover.

FOUR! Perfect skill, timing and balance! Akeal Hosein has done this for the second time now. Josh Little overpitches this one, on middle. Akeal Hosein drives it with the full face of his bat past mid on for a boundary.
Bowling change. Josh Little is back on. He is on two warnings for running on the danger area.
Beaten! Tossed up and outside off, Holder goes back to play at it late but is beaten.
Clips a full ball off his pads to square leg. Dot.
Full and on middle, flicked aerially to the right of long on for a couple.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Shorter this time, outside off. Jason Holder hangs back and looks to punch but gets beaten on the outside edge. A shout for caught behind, but the umpire says no.
Fuller, on off. Akeal Hosein gets across and clips it to mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball, around middle, Akeal Hosein flicks it to the fielder at square leg.
Full ball, outside off. Akeal Hosein plays it towards third man for a single.
On a length, outside off. Akeal Hosein cuts it to the fielder at backward point.
Outside off, full delivery. Akeal Hosein drives it powerfully but finds the mid off fielder.
Fuller, on the pads. Jason Holder works it away towards square leg for a single.
On a length, jags back in a tad. Jason Holder nudges this towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Very full, around off. Jason Holder digs it out back to the bowler.
Swing and a miss! Another full ball, outside off. Akeal Hosein hangs back and looks to punch this but gets beaten as the ball turns away a tad.
Tosses it up, on middle. Jason Holder pushes it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Outside off, fuller in length. Jason Holder steers it to backward point.
Loopy ball, on middle. Jason Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Akeal Hosein forces it to long off for a single.
Flatter, on the pads. Akeal Hosein, on the back foot, flicks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on the body. Akeal Hosein works it towards fine leg for a single. He retains the strike.
Outside off, a touch fuller. Akeal Hosein leans forward and defends it on the off side.
FOUR! Glorious drive! Another fuller ball, around middle and off, Akeal Hosein drills it past the mid off fielder for a boundary. Vital runs these for West Indies.
Another length ball, on the pads this time. Akeal Hosein misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. No run taken.
On a length, outside off. Akeal Hosein blocks it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Mark Adair overpitches this delivery, sprays it down the leg side this time. Akeal Hosein just tickles it towards fine leg for a boundary. 150 up!

PUT DOWN! Craig Young is the culprit. That's a bad and costly miss. Flighted and full outside off, Holder presses forward for the cover drive but fails to middle his shot. Ends up slicing it towards backward point where Young puts down a sitter.
Flighted ball, around off. Jason Holder blocked this one out.
Fuller, outside off. Jason Holder pushes it to cover. No run there.
Flatter, outside off. Jason Holder leaves it alone.

FOUR! EDGY! West Indies will not mind that. Another fuller ball, around off. Jason Holder presses forward and goes for the drive, but gets a thick outside edge past the slip fielder. The ball races away towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Paul Stirling begins with a loopy ball, outside off. Jason Holder looks to drive but misses.
Fractionally short and on off, Akeal is on his toes as he punches it to covers. Not in the gap though.
Angling in from a fuller length, Holder flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Drifting down the leg side, Akeal fails to flick. It goes off his pads towards the keeper who only makes a partial stop with a dive. A leg bye is taken.
Outside off, left alone.

Confusion, almost a run out. Shortish and on middle, Hosein plays it down in front of square leg and sets off for a non-existent single. He is sent back as George Dockrell misses his shy at the striker's end.
Wide! Down the leg side, Akeal tries to glance but misses.
Back of a length, outside off, steered in front of square on the off side for a single.

DRINKS! Ireland have been dominating so far. They are just 3 wickets away from bundling the hosts out. Jason Holder is standing tall at the crease, he is probably the man who can guide West Indies to a defendable total from here.
Comes from 'round the wicket and delivers a flatter ball on the pads, Holder flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on off, Holder gets back and defends it on the leg side.
Spinning down the leg side, helped to square leg.

FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and flighted outside off, Holder leans into the drive and caresses it through covers for a boundary. Holder is playing a critical knock here for West Indies, showing controlled aggression at the moment.
Floated and around off, Jason is forward in defense.
Arm ball around off, skidding in, Akeal gets back and forces it to long on for a single.
Beaten! Young serves it full and wide outside off, Holder is lured into the drive away from his body and gets beaten.
Shortish and close to off, Holder stays back and tries to run it down to third man but it takes the bottom edge and rolls away to point.
Stays low! Angling in from a length around off, Holder defends it well in the end by crouching a bit.
FOUR! Put away! Short in length and on middle, Holder gets on top of the bounce and pulls it to the deep square leg fence.
On middle, landing around leg, Holder clips it past mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Right on the button, full and on off, Holder blocks it off his front foot.
Craig Young (5-0-22-2) is brought back into the attack.
Full and on off, skidding in, Akeal defends it off his front foot.
Stretches forward to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Full and on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Superb delivery. Tossed up around off, not turning much, Holder goes back to flick but is squared up and gets it out off the leading edge.
Full and flighted on off, this time Holder flicks it to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full around off, Holder gets forward and defends near his front pad.
Man with the golden arm, Andy McBrine (6-1-13-3) is back on!
Another short ball, outside off, Akeal Hosein plays it from the back foot to point.
Mishit! Back of a length, outside off, Akeal tries to punch but gets a bottom edge.
Shortish and outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Around off, on a length, defended from the back foot.
FOUR! Eased away! A touch short and angling down the leg side, Holder neatly deflects it down to fine leg and fetches a rare boundary for West Indies.
Fullish and on off, Holder helps it with the angle of the bowler to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Holder gets back and punches it down to long on for a run. He holds the key now for the home team.
Akeal Hosein is the new man at the crease.

OUT! Shepherd holes out! Flighted and full around off, Romario decides to take on Dockrell and aims to send this delivery into the stands at long on. His connection though is not proper and Mark Adair runs across to his right in the deep to claim the catch easily. With so many overs left, this was a reckless shot selection. West Indies slip further.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b George Dockrell

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy and full around off, Holder drives it back past the bowler for a single at long off.
Leans forward to a full ball around middle and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, cut to deep point for a run.
Floated and on off, Shepherd gets forward and inside-edges his attempted front-foot defense onto the pads.
Lands it on a length around off, shaping in, Holder stays back and plays it down defensively to mid-wicket.
Shortish and on off, Romario Shepherd rises on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length around middle, Romario wrists it across the line but finds mid-wicket.
Short again, close to off, this time Romario Shepherd pulls it aerially over mid-wicket. It drops safely in the deep and then stops on its own. They take a couple.
Swing and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Shepherd tries to cut but misses.
Sliding down the leg side, Jason eases it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Flatter and a touch shorter around off, Romario Shepherd punches it back to the bowler.

Shout for an lbw! Not given. Floated around leg, straightening a touch, Romario gets back to defend but misses. He is hit on the pads, George Dockrell appeals but nothing from the umpire. Maybe, missing leg.
Goes on the back foot and works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Full and on off, skidding in, Holder tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and rolls to square leg.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot.
Beaten! A touch short and outside off, holding its line, Shepherd pokes inside the line and misses. Top over!
Delivers it on a length again, Romario is forward as he pushes it to mid off.
On a length, around off, blocked.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Back of a length, around leg, nudged behind square leg for a brace.
Fuller on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Much needed boundary for West Indies! Another loopy ball, full and on middle. Romario Shepherd gets down and goes for the sweep but gets a top edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Full, down the leg side this time. Romario Shepherd goes for the sweep but misses. Wide called.
Another full ball, on off. Romario Shepherd pushes it back to George Dockrell.
Fuller outside off. Romario Shepherd defends it out on the off side.
Appeal for a catch! The umpire shakes his head and Paul Stirling goes for the review. Flat-line as the ball passes the bat, confirms the UltraEdge.

NOT OUT! A huge shout for a catch but the umpire is unmoved. Another loopy ball, outside off. Romario Shepherd leans and looks to drive this but gets beaten as the ball turns away from him. It brushes the pads of the keeper and goes to first slip. Paul Stirling thinks there was an edge on that and opts for a review. UltraEgde confirms that there is no bat involved in that. The decision stands! Romario Shepherd survives.
Another full ball, outside off. Romario Shepherd drives it through cover for a brace.
Very full, slower through the air. Romario Shepherd waits for it and blocks it out watchfully.
Length, outside off. Jason Holder blocks this towards point. End of a successful over!
George Dockrell is into the attack now.
Another length ball, outside off. Romario Shepherd cuts it towards third man for a single.
Romario Shepherd, the hero with the bat in the last match, walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Curtis Campher strikes in his first over. And, Roston Chase fails once again. A fuller ball, on middle, Roston Chase flicks this from the inner half of his bat. The ball flies and goes straight to Paul Stirling at mid-wicket, who gets low and takes an excellent catch. West Indies are in deeper trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery, slanting it down on the leg side. Roston Chase misses his flick. The ball deflects off his pad and goes to the keeper.
Outside off, on a length. Roston Chase defends it out.
On a length, around middle. Jason Holder taps it towards square leg for a single.
Curtis Campher is into the attack now.
Quicker and shorter. Roston Chase clips it to square leg.
Much slower through the air, full and around off. Roston Chase pushes it to the left of the bowler. Andy McBrine does well to dive to his left and stop the ball.

BEATEN! Change of angle this time. Andy McBrine goes around the wicket, serves a full ball, outside off. Roston Chase looks to defend this but gets beaten on the outside edge and the ball flies over the off stump.
Loopy ball, full in length, Jason Holder drives it through mid on for a single. 100 up!
Another full ball, on middle. Jason Holder leans and defends it out.
Full, on middle. Jason Holder defends it out.
A length ball, outside off. Roston Chase presses forward and blocks it out. Maiden!
Back of a length, on middle. Roston Chase tucks it to mid-wicket.
DRS time! Appeal for a caught behind has not been entertained by the umpire and Paul Stirling is reviewing it. Off the pads, shows the UltraEdge.

NOT OUT! A huge shout for caught behind, but the umpire says no. Another beauty by Josh Little. He is causing some serious trouble here! A length ball, nipping back in on middle. Roston Chase tries to block but gets beaten on the inside edge. He gets hit on the pads and the ball flies back to the keeper. They appeal for a caught behind. The replay rolls in. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes the bat. The third umpire also checks for the lbw but the Ball Tracking indicates that it was missing the wickets. The on-field decision stands.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Roston Chase pushes it towards point. Three dots in a row now.
On a length this time, outside off. Chase pushes it to extra cover. No run there.
Back of a length, outside off. Roston Chase opens the face of his bat and guides it to the man at point.
Jason Holder comes to the crease now.

OUT! That's a sensational one-handed grab from William Porterfield and Kieron Pollard's misery at the crease is put to an end. Andy McBrine gets his third in the match and continues to have a good time in West Indies. He delivers it on that in-between length that confuses the batsman. Neither too short nor too full. Around off, turning back in with some extra bounce. Pollard hangs back and attempts to tickle it around the corner. But it takes the inside half and goes quickly to leg slip. William Porterfield shows great reflexes as he sticks his right hand out to catch it. West Indies have now lost half their side and staring down the barrel.
Commentary.Howout: c William Porterfield b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: Howzzat? Just outside the line. Full and floated, just outside off, Pollard leans forward to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg.
Goes on the back foot and uses the spin on the ball to work it to deep square leg. A single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Chase goes back and defends it down.
FOUR! Fine shot! A little too full from Andy McBrine, outside off, Roston Chase leans forward and thumps it through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Fuller and around off, driven to covers.

Pollard is struggling big time at the moment, both against spin and swing. Little delivers an inswinger, Kieron's feet stay glued to the crease as he tries to defend. The ball though nips back in and whistles past the inside edge.
Beauty, that's excellent from Little. He goes full and outside off, the ball lands and straightens as Pollard tries to reach out for it. Gets beaten comprehensively.
Fractionally short and on off, Pollard goes back and offers a straight willow in defense.
Back of a length, around off and slanting in, Pollard gets close to the delivery and does well to deal with the extra bounce as he jams it down.
Another delivery landing on a length outside off, Chase outside-edges his attempted drive to third man. A single is taken.
Angles in a length ball on off, Chase remains on the back foot in defense.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it with gentle hands to mid-wicket.
Beaten all ends up! Andy is all over Kieron here. Floated and around off, Pollard stays back to play for the turn but it beats the outside edge.
Grip and turn as it lands around middle. Pollard offers no shot and wears it on his pads.
Goes on the back foot and works it with the spin to square leg.
Full again, around off, defended back.
Full and flighted on off, Pollard flicks it with the spin to square leg.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Josh Little dishes out a fuller delivery, around middle, Chase brings down a straight bat and drills it down through mid on for a boundary.
Edgy again! Fullish and outside off, Pollard tries to lunge and push it through covers but it takes the inside edge, beats the stumps and races away to fine leg. They cross.
On a length and outside off, Roston steers it with an angled bat through backward point for one.
Edged but safe! Full and wide outside off, Chase tries to drive but edges it behind. It doesn't carry to Stirling at first slip.
Angling in from a fuller length around off, Pollard eases it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
That is defended solidly off the front foot.
Josh Little (3-0-25-0) is brought back into the attack. He is already on two warnings for running on the danger area.
Beaten! Tossed up, outside off, Chase goes back to defend but it skids off the surface to beat the outside edge. End of another top over from Andy!
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
Goes on the back foot and helps it wide of leg slip.
Fullish and outside off, Pollard drives it to covers for a single.

Missed stumping chance! Full and flighted outside off, Pollard plays for the turn and gets beaten on the outside edge. The replays show that Pollard's back foot was stretching forward too much and it was on the line with nothing behind. Neil Rock though didn't collect the ball and Kieron gets a life. Could be a big miss.
Kieron Pollard walks out to bat at number 6.

OUT! Dead plumb! West Indies are digging a hole for themselves. Andy McBrine gives this one a good toss and lands the off spinner around off. It kisses the deck and spins back in, Shamarh Brooks decides to go deep inside the crease and pull it across the line but misses. He is struck on the back pad, they appeal and the finger goes up immediately. Sitting duck. Should have been forward, Brooks. The hosts have lost their in-form batter. In dire straits now.

Drinks break. The template has remained the same for West Indies in this series. They start decently with the bat but then lose the plot after the 10th over mark. Shai Hope was sensational during his stay but got carried away with his quickfire knock and played one shot too many. His partner Justin Greaves once again fell driving loosely at a delivery. Ireland have done well to get back in the contest after a sorry start. Let's see how the middle phase pans out.
Back of a length, outside off. Roston Chase stands tall and punches it wide of off. Dot to the end over.
Full, in that channel outside off. Roston Chase gets a bottom edge back to the keeper as he tries to push inside the line.
FOUR! Nicely done! Another full delivery, around middle and leg. Roston Chase uses his wrists and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary
Overpitches this one, around middle and off. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards mid-wicket. A misfield there, allows the batters to take a single.
A huge shout for an LBW, but the umpire says no! A length ball, shaping back in on the pads. Shamarh Brooks looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Height was the issue here.
Fuller length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Tosses it up, around middle. Roston Chase leans and blocks it out.
Roston Chase pushes it towards square leg. No run taken.
FOUR! Tickled fine. Turning down the leg side, Chase tries to flick and it possibly takes the inside half before racing wide of leg slip for a boundary at fine leg.
Loopy ball, full. Roston Chase blocks it out.
Roston Chase, yet another batsman going through a poor form, comes in next.

OUT! LBW! Need a wicket? Call Andy McBrine! He carries his form from the previous game! What a peach of a delivery! Nicholas Pooran fails once again. A loopy ball, landing around leg and then spinning towards off. Nicholas Pooran leans across to flick but misses. It beats his bat and goes on to rap him on the back pad. The ball lobs to Stirling who catches it at first slip and Ireland start appealing. The umpire thinks and thinks before raising his finger. Pooran perhaps thinks that he is given out caught and reviews straightaway. But as it turns out, the appeal was for an lbw and the DRS finds everything adjacent. Pooran will have to depart.

Huge shout for an lbw! The umpire thinks and thinks before raising his finger. Nicholas Pooran immediately reviews. There is no bat involved, UltraEdge has confirmed it. Ball Tracking comes and puts a full stop to Pooran's stay. Everything in line.
Tossing it up, on middle. Nicholas Pooran prods and blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, outside off. Shamarh Brooks shoulders his arms at it. End of a successful over!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Shamarh Brooks hangs back and defends it out.
Shamarh Brooks walks in next. Two new batsmen at the crease and Ireland would like to make more inroads now.

OUT! TAKEN! Craig Young with another wicket! Two wickets for him now! Young overpitches this one, outside off. Justin Greaves looks to drive this but he manages to get a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards backward point and Harry Tector dives to his left to take a superb low catch. Three times in the series, Greaves has got out driving. There is certainly a deficiency in his technique that he needs to sort out.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Very full, on middle, Justin Greaves drags it back to the bowler.
Quick single! Touch fuller, around the off pole. Nicholas Pooran taps it towards covers and takes a tight single.
On a length, outside off. Justin Greaves guides it to third man for a single.
Slower through the air, around middle. Nicholas Pooran pushes it back to the bowler. 2 runs off Andy McBrine's first over! A tidy start!
Touch quicker, around middle. Nicholas Pooran stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Full, on middle, Justin Greaves drags it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Another loopy ball, full in length and around off. Nicholas Pooran presses forward and pushes it towards cover-point for a single. He gets off the mark with that single.
Adding flight once again, fuller and around off. Nicholas Pooran drives it to the man at covers. Dot ball.
Andy Balbirnie starts off with a loopy ball, full and on middle. Nicholas Pooran leans and blocks it out solidly.

Nicholas Pooran walks in next at number 3. 14 runs in this series so far for him, he needs runs to justify his place in the XI. Also, there is a bowling change, Andy McBrine is into the attack. A slip in place and the big frame of Paul Stirling is occupying that region.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ireland have got the breakthrough! Shai Hope departs after a gem of an innings! Craig Young picks up the first wicket! Change of length this time, a shorter one, around off. Shai Hope pulls this towards deep backward square leg. He gets all the elevation but no distance as it came off the top edge. Josh Little runs to his left from fine leg and takes a sharp tumbling catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Little b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Quick single! Fuller, around off. Justin Greaves taps it to mid off and takes off to the other end. Good running!
On a length, outside off. Justin Greaves shows the full face of his bat and defends it out.
Craig Young delivers a full delivery, nipping back in a tad, around off. Shai Hope pushes it past covers and rotates the strike.
A low full toss, around middle and leg. Justin Greaves works it away towards mid on and scampers through to the other end. A single is taken.
An inswinger this time, full and on middle, Justin Greaves blocks it out solidly.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

FOUR! Glorious shot to bring a majestic fifty, the fastest of his career, coming off just 37 balls. Short in length and around off, Hope goes on the back foot and strokes it through the gap at covers. At the end of Powerplay 1, West Indies are 69/0.
Wide! Angling down the leg side, Hope tries to flick but misses.
We are good to resume...

SIX! Boom! Shai s not shy to use his feet. Advances down the track to a length delivery outside off and lofts it nonchalantly over covers for a maximum. Thank God, Sheldon Cottrell's car is not parked there today. The ball returns from the stand and it seems there is some damage done. Nopes, the umpire is only sanitizing it.
Once again some extra bounce as it approaches the batsman from a good length, Hope is cramped for room and keeps it out to the off side.
In the channel outside off, Hope lets it through.

Edgy! Short in length around off, some extra bounce, Justin Greaves tries to play at it but seeing the extra bounce he attempts to withdraw his bat. The ball though takes the bottom half of his blade and goes through the gap at point. They collect one.
Angling down the leg side, it's worked behind square leg for a brace.

On a length around off, Shai tries to tap and run but the point fielder quickly gets to the ball and Hope aborts the plan. The fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end but it's a needless one. The ball deflects away but Shai doesn't want a run.
A hint of away movement from a length around off, Justin Greaves looks to defend but it catches the outside edge and runs down to third man. They cross for a run.
Back of a length, on off, Greaves punches it from the back foot to cover-point.
A leg-stump half-volley, Hope flicks it to deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Shortish again, around off, Hope tries to play the cross-batted shot from the back foot but gets into a tangle and only manages to mistime his shot to mid on.
Young delivers it short and around off, Shai rises on the back foot and cuts it towards point. Straight to the fielder though.
Fuller and on middle, angling down, Hope fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. They collect a leg bye to round off the over, 9 from it.
FOUR! My word, have a look at that! Short and around off, Hope is on the back foot in a flash as he pummels it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 up in quick time!
A touch short again, around off and angling in, Shai goes on the back foot and defends it down.
EDGED AND FOUR! Slightly short in length and around off, shaping away after landing, Hope pushes inside the line and edges it through the vacant second slip region for a boundary.
Angling in from a good length outside off, Hope goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
In the region outside off, on a length, Hope allows it through to the keeper.
Straighter in line, it's turned in the gap at mid-wicket for a run. 10 from the over, a very positive start from the home team.

FOUR! Hope continues to be ultra-aggressive. Short in length and around off, Shai goes back and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket for a boundary - his sixth in the match already. This now is the best Powerplay for West Indies in the series.
FOUR! Nicely timed. Fuller in length, around off and angling in too much, Shai Hope leans across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pitches it up and around off, shaping in, Shai presses forward and defends it back. His bottom hand comes off the handle in the process.
Back of a length, on middle, Greaves goes back and turns it through backward square leg. The call from him is to 'push hard' but only one run is available.
Beaten straightaway! Young delivers it on a length and close to off, the ball straightens after landing as Greaves feels for it inside the line.
Craig Young comes into the attack. He replaces Josh Little.
Back of a length, around off, Shai defends it from the back foot. Another tidy over by Adair, just a couple of wides from it.
Fractionally short and around off, angling in, Hope is on the back foot as he plays it down to mid-wicket.
Wide! Full and angling down the leg side, Hope tries his best to flick but misses.
It's served on a good length around off, Hope goes on his toes to block it on the off side.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.

Shout for a caught behind! The umpire remains still. Back of a length, angling down the leg side, Shai tries to flick but fails to connect cleanly. The Irish keeper goes down low to collect the ball and once again they appeal. Nothing from the umpire. Paul Stirling decides not to take the referral as advised by his players. The replays show that it came of Hope's thigh pad.
Extra bounce from a length around off, Shai goes back and does well to defend it to the off side.
Sliding down the leg side with some extra bounce, Hope tries to tickle it fine but misses. Neil Rock does well to collect it. There is a stifled appeal for an lbw but nothing doing.
Around off on a length, Hope gets back and tucks it in front of square leg for a single. 13 from the over, West Indies are off to a flying start!
FOUR! Hope is looking in fine form this morning. Plenty of room available, on a length and outside off, Shai exercises his arms and powers it over covers for a boundary.
A little bit of width outside off, Hope hits it through the line but finds point.
On a length and outside off, Shai offers no shot.
FOUR! Crunched! Short and outside off, Shai Hope hangs on the back foot and smashes it through cover-point for a boundary.

FOUR! Little is forced to bowl from 'round the wicket to avoid the danger area. He delivers it on a length close to off and the ball swerves back in with the angle and the seam movement. Shai Hope tries to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes to the fine leg fence.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump. Maiden!
Uses the angle of the bowler and works it gently towards wide mid on.
Beauty! Adair delivers it full and just outside off, shaping back in big, Greaves tries to defend off the front foot but is beaten on the inside edge. The ball goes over the stumps.
Around off on a length, Greaves gets back and defends it to the off side.
In the zone outside off, once again Justin Greaves offers no shot.
On a length around off, shaping in, Greaves shoulders arms.

Angling away from the batsman, Hope pushes inside the line and edges it down to third man for a couple of runs. Little gets the second official warning now, another instance of stepping on the danger area and he won't be allowed to bowl. Josh tries to plead his case but the umpire stays put.
The batsman has just blocked that from his crease.
On a length around middle, defended on the leg side. Josh Little gets an official warning for running on the danger area.

FOUR! That's an absolutely cracking shot! Little continues to be on the shorter side, around off, Hope transfers his weight on the back foot and punches it sweetly through the gap at cover-point. That's the first boundary of the match.
A bit edgy! Width on offer outside off, short in length, Justin throws his bat at it and plays it off the outer edge to third man. The fielder there is a bit square and hence only a run.
Beautiful timing! Back of a length around off, Shai is on his back foot as he steers it through point. Good placement and they get three runs.
Slightly short and on off, Justin taps it down on the off side and sets off for a run. A loud no comes from his partner. A tidy start from Mark Adair.
Pitches it up and around off, nipping away, Greaves covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
On a length around middle, Hope eases it in front of square leg and steals a run. Both the openers are showing good intensity.
Fractionally short and around off, shaping in a shade, Greaves goes on his toes and drops it with gentle hands to square leg. They scamper across for a run.
In the channel outside off, moving away, Justin makes a watchful leave.
Wide! Shortish but way wide outside off, an easy leave for the batter.
A gentle outswinger, outside off and shaping away, Greaves allows it through to the keeper.
Mark Adair will bowl from the other end.

Short and on middle, rising more than anticipated, Greaves does well to stand tall and play it down on the leg side. They cross for a quick run as the bowler attempts to kick the ball on the stumps at the striker's end.
Stifled appeal for an lbw! Fuller and around off, shaping in, Justin Greaves gets forward to drive but there is a MASSIVE INSIDE EDGE as it raps him on the pads. The appeal dies down soon.
Back of a length, on off, Justin Greaves goes on the back foot and plays it down to the off side. Not in the gap.
Beaten! Angling across the batsman, around off, Greaves feels for it inside the line and misses. And again, the umpire makes sure to let know where Little cannot step.

FOUR LEG BYES! There is some movement for Little but the line is down the leg side. Justin Greaves fails to flick but it clips his thigh pad and runs wide of the keeper to find the fence at fine leg. The umpire is seen having a word with Josh Little for running on the danger area. No official warning.
Josh begins with a short delivery outside off, Hope goes on his toes and punches it in the gap at extra cover for a single.

Time to get underway. The players from both sides are in the middle as they take the knee to show their support against racism. Shai Hope and Justin Greaves are ready to open the innings for West Indies. Josh Little has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Jeff Dujon says that it's bright today and the pitch looks the same as the previous games. Adds that there is a nice covering of grass and also there is a bit of moisture, which means the team batting first will have to be cautious in the beginning and capitalize at the end.

After losing three tosses in a row, Kieron Pollard, the captain of West Indies, says that toss is always 50-50 but right now it's 100-0. Adds that you have to adjust to the conditions as there will be moisture early on. Feels that they have done well in the first 10 overs but struggled after that. Wants his boys to dig a bit deeper and get the job done. Tells that they have practised hard on their fielding and admits that they are still a work in progress. Mentions that they have to be sharp in this match as it's all to play for. Informs that they are also going with the same XI.

Paul Stirling, the captain of Ireland, says that they are fielding first and want to do the same process. Feels the pitch has not changed from the last game. Tells that they have not played their best game yet and hopes to put up a neat performance in this match. Wants his bowlers to get disciplined and work on the extras. On his personal form, Paul is happy to get some time in the middle in the last match. Informs that they are going unchanged.

West Indies (Unchanged Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Justin Greaves, Nicholas Pooran, Shamarh Brooks, Kieron Pollard (C), Roston Chase, Jason Holder, Romario Shepherd, Odean Smith, Alzarri Joseph and Akeal Hosein.

Ireland (Unchanged Playing XI) - Paul Stirling (C), William Porterfield, Andy McBrine, Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Gareth Delany, Neil Rock (WK), Mark Adair, Craig Young and Josh Little.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Ireland. They have elected to BOWL first.

Ireland, on the other hand, will be coming into this game a little high on confidence after winning the previous contest. Andy McBrine has been their star performer as he has displayed his magic with the bat and with the ball. Harry Tector too has been impressive after scoring half-centuries in both the games and made the middle order strong. Although Craig Young and Josh Little have been doing well with the ball, they have leaked runs towards the end and will try not to repeat the same. Paul Stirling will continue to lead the side in this big game and will be hoping to emerge victoriously. An exciting match coming your way! Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

The hosts did exceedingly well to win the first match, they were exceptional with the ball, however, they were not able to replicate the same in the rain-affected second ODI. In both the games, West Indies put up a decent total, but the likes of Shai Hope and Nicholas Pooran have not been at their best at the top order and they will need to step up in this decider to provide West Indies with the desired start. Romario Shepherd and Odean Smith have been doing a fine job and they will be hoping to continue their sublime form. We could see West Indies coming into this game unchanged.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and the final ODI of this intriguing series between West Indies and Ireland. After all the postponements due to Covid, it is time for the decider of the series which is firmly poised at 1-1. We can expect both teams to perform at their best to clinch the series and grab valuable points at the ICC Cricket World Cup Super League. Unlike the second ODI, the weather for today seems clear and there are low possibilities of rain.
... MATCH DAY ...
